reason: The accepted C16 evidence contains native timing and semantic NCU aggregates, but no accepted instruction/address trace covering the full inter-token model traffic and exact qweight allocation intervals needed for an L2 replacement experiment.

minimum_capture_scope.interval: at least two consecutive stable decode iterations, beginning before the selected D2 target uses and ending after their D3 reuses
minimum_capture_scope.traffic: all intervening model memory traffic, not target kernels alone
identity: exact L0-up, L14-up, and L0-down qweight intervals in a SHA-pinned sidecar
minimum_capture_scope.pc: capture/preserve only to keep later static-PC analysis possible; oracle-region tagging does not depend on PC
